text: Domain 3 splits into two families of tooling — monitoring answers 'what happened,' deployment answers 'how did it get there' — and DP-700 loves to put one family's name where the other is correct.

Monitoring Hub, observability, and alerts answer 'what happened, does someone need to know.' Deployment pipelines, Git integration, and blue-green rollouts answer 'how does a change get promoted safely.'

Monitoring Hub shows what ran and whether it succeeded. Alerts push a notification the moment something fails. Deployment pipelines promote an item from Dev to Test to Prod — a different job entirely.

A team wants notebook changes tested before Production, with an approval trail. The Monitoring Hub shows run history, not code changes. Git integration plus deployment pipelines gives both the trail and the gate.
Sort every scenario into its family before reading the options. Next up: the honest list of traps and gotchas that show up across every domain.
